algorithm.description: Seasonal exponential smoothing with a weekly cycle, fit per call on the supplied history.
steps: Validate and gap-fill the sales history
Fit trend and weekly seasonality components
Project forward over the requested horizon
Derive prediction intervals from in-sample residuals

horizon_days.effect: Longer horizons widen the prediction intervals.

interval_level.effect: Higher coverage widens the bounds; the point estimate is unaffected.

forecast.uncertainty: lower/upper bounds at the requested interval_level accompany each point estimate
forecast.interpretation: The point estimate is the median outcome; plan capacity against the upper bound.

constraints.description: Supply more history or shorten the horizon.

errors.when: history contains fewer than 28 days after gap-filling
errors.hint: Fetch a longer sales history and retry.
